candidates.summary: the rewritten SecureHeadersMiddleware call is the only place the gateway reaches the served CSP, and no test covers that wiring
candidates.failure_scenario: Replace the 4th argument appcfg.RenderConfig.IPFSGateway with "" (or move the call before NewRouter so it gets the raw flag). Every test stays green: setupWeb returns only a ListenAndServe closure, so main_test.go:80-157 check only its error, and TestSecureHeadersMiddlewareIPFSGateway calls the middleware with a literal. gnoweb in strict mode then renders under an img-src without the gateway, and the browser blocks every IPFS image, the breakage this PR exists to fix.
candidates.verify_by: in a scratch worktree: sed -i '401s/appcfg.RenderConfig.IPFSGateway)/"")/' gno.land/cmd/gnoweb/main.go && go test ./gno.land/cmd/gnoweb/ ; expect red, observe green
candidates.evidence: grep -n 'setupWeb(\|Content-Security-Policy\|ServeHTTP' gno.land/cmd/gnoweb/*_test.go: setupWeb at 80,84,89,102,106,157 checks err only; every CSP read (173,205,250) is on a handler built by a direct SecureHeadersMiddleware call

candidates.summary: gnodev's -web-ipfs-gateway wiring has no test: deleting the line that copies it into the gnoweb config leaves every gnodev test green
candidates.failure_scenario: Delete setup_web.go:42 (appcfg.RenderConfig.IPFSGateway = cfg.webIPFSGateway). NewDefaultAppConfig leaves the gateway empty, so gnodev stops rewriting ipfs:// and retired-gateway URLs and -web-ipfs-gateway does nothing; setup_web_test.go only asserts NoIndex, TrustedPaths and IndexCommunity, and no gnodev test mentions ipfs.
candidates.verify_by: in a scratch worktree: sed -i '42d' contribs/gnodev/setup_web.go && go -C contribs/gnodev test ./... ; expect red, observe green. Fix: in TestGnoWebAppConfigNoIndex's loop, assert gnoWebAppConfig(&cfg, "").RenderConfig.IPFSGateway == gnoweb.DefaultIPFSGateway
candidates.evidence: grep -rn -i ipfs contribs/gnodev --include='*_test.go' returned nothing; setup_web_test.go:20-31 asserts TrustedPaths, IndexCommunity and NoIndex only

candidates.summary: the diff removes ipfs.io from the CSP, the traefik CSP and the r/docs/markdown host list, but p/moul/web25 still builds its link as https://ipfs.io/ipfs/<CID>
candidates.failure_scenario: web25.Config.GetLink() returns https://ipfs.io/ipfs/<CID>, and Render substitutes it into 'Click [here]({link})'. gnoweb with a gateway rewrites it at render time, but the value read any other way (gnobro, a qeval of GetLink, gnoweb with -ipfs-gateway "") points at ipfs.io, which now answers with HTTP/2 403 and cf-mitigated: challenge. The PR's own docs say to prefer ipfs://, and this is the one example package that writes the markdown itself, so it can follow that advice. r/sacha/coinflip/render.gno:70 and r/sacha/home/home.gno:21 also hardcode ipfs.io but go through md.Image, which rejects ipfs://, so they rely on the rewrite.
candidates.verify_by: git grep -n 'ipfs.io/ipfs' -- examples ; then render web25.Config{CID: "bafybeigdyrzt5sfp7udm7hu76uh7y26nf3efuylqabf3oclgtqy55fbzdi"}.Render("") through NewHTMLRenderer with IPFSGateway "" and with the default, and compare the href. Fix: return "ipfs://" + c.CID
candidates.evidence: git grep 'ipfs\.io' hit examples/quarantined/gno.land/p/moul/web25/web25.gno:29, r/sacha/coinflip/render.gno:70 and r/sacha/home/home.gno:21; web25.gno:49 uses strings.ReplaceAll(text, "{link}", c.GetLink()); curl -H 'Sec-Fetch-Dest: image' https://ipfs.io/ipfs/bafy... returned HTTP/2 403 with cf-mitigated: challenge
